entry.name: Opera
entry.verified: .deb: SHA-256 matches Opera's .sha256sum; the same version's .rpm has a good signature from Opera's archive key 6C86BE214648376680CA957B11EE8C00B693A745 (rpmkeys -K on Rocky 8) and an identical opera binary. operadriver zip: SHA-256 matches GitHub's asset digest
entry.notes: The .deb's /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/opera-stable unpacked to ~/ibbrowsers/opera-135 (no root); a plain copy, so it never updates. Needs glibc 2.25. The driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh. operadriver 151 is Opera's driver for Opera Stable 135.
